summary: iter29 frontend-only validation of ProjectDialog multi-day tech removal UX (QYLOT). All 7 scenarios from the bug fix passed. Seed project TEST_QA_Client was configured via PUT /api/projects/{id} with scheduled_date=2026-10-20, duration_days=3, assigned_to=[TEST_Tech_QA, TEST_Tech2_QA], then reconfigured for single-day and duration=1+extra_dates variants. All data-testids present and behavior is systematic.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for Radix DialogContent (a11y). Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDialog.jsx is >900 lines — could be split (photo lightbox portal + remove-choice dialog + main form).
In toggleTech, when the user restores an excluded day via chip, both excluded chip removal and toggleTech paths exist (consistent, but duplicated logic). Minor DRY opportunity.
Radix Dialog a11y warning (missing aria-describedby) on project-dialog + sub-dialogs — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby for accessibility compliance.
seed_data_creation: Reused existing TEST_QA_Client project (id 32520b11-dcd3-4864-9969-b96ed12cf1d9). Mutated via PUT /api/projects/{id} and RESTORED at the end to scheduled_date=2026-10-20 duration=1 assigned_to=[] day_exclusions={} extra_dates=[]. No new persistent data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ProjectDialog remove-choice dialog data-testids used: project-remove-choice-dialog, project-remove-day-picker, project-remove-day-YYYY-MM-DD, project-remove-this-day-btn, project-remove-whole-btn, project-remove-cancel, project-tech-excl-{techId}-{date}. Project tech checkbox: project-tech-checkbox-{techId}. Tech IDs: TEST_Tech_QA=4ab3bb75-49dd-4596-87b2-854de046c33f, TEST_Tech2_QA=f9b0949b-a45c-4f41-ab71-c71ecb03eb2f. Login must be submitted via Enter key (page.press on password), form onSubmit misfires with Button click force=True.
verified_scenarios: Planning day 2 cell → uncheck tech → dialog appears with 2026-10-21 preselected (amber-500), label 'Uniquement le 21/10'. Save persists day_exclusion.
Kanban (no contextDate) → uncheck → dialog appears with first day (2026-10-20) preselected. Switching to 2026-10-22 updates label to 'Uniquement le 22/10'.
duration_days=1 + extra_dates=['2026-10-23'] → uncheck shows dialog with exactly 2 day buttons (2026-10-20 and 2026-10-23).
'Tout le chantier' button removes tech from assigned_to (checkbox unchecked, saved).
Single-day project (duration=1, no extra_dates) → uncheck removes directly, NO dialog appears.
'Retiré le' amber chip (project-tech-excl-{techId}-{date}) appears next to tech name for excluded days (other than contextDate) and clicking it restores the tech for that day.
Scenarios repeated across Planning and Kanban origins — behavior is systematic.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix verified. Previous code only showed the remove-choice dialog when (a) opened from a Planning cell (had contextDate) AND (b) duration_days>1. Fix now uses projectDays.length>1 (consecutive duration + non-consecutive extra_dates) and no longer requires contextDate, so Kanban origin and non-consecutive multi-day projects also trigger the dialog systematically.
